title: v5.1.13 — Faster Launch & Fixes
message:
Quicker and cleaner!

⚡ App now launches straight into the hub — no more FluxBucks splash screen on open
🛒 Profile pill no longer overlaps the shop button — it now sits on its own row above the bottom buttons
👆 'Tap Outside to Close' setting now actually works on every popup (was previously only working on a few)
🧹 Behind-the-scenes cleanup
